segments.name: Battery & Energy Products
segments.description: Manufactures and markets Lithium non-rechargeable and rechargeable batteries, power supplies, and charging systems for military, industrial, medical and commercial applications.
segments.evidence: The Battery & Energy Products segment includes Lithium 9-volt, cylindrical, thin cell and other non-rechargeable batteries, in addition to rechargeable batteries, uninterruptable power supplies, charging systems and accessories.

segments.name: Communications Systems
segments.description: Designs and manufactures communications systems, RF amplifiers, and integrated systems for military and commercial defense applications.
segments.evidence: The Communications Systems segment includes RF amplifiers, power supplies, cable and connector assemblies, amplified speakers, equipment mounts, case equipment, man-portable systems, integrated communication systems for fixed or vehicle applications and communications and electronics systems design.

revenueModel.text: Customers include government, defense departments, OEMs, industrial and defense supply distributors purchasing products directly or through various trade channels.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products worldwide through a variety of trade channels, including original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs"), industrial and defense supply distributors, and directly to U.S. and foreign defense departments.

changes.text: In 2025, the company underwent a comprehensive rebranding initiative consolidating all sub-brands under the Ultralife master brand, resulting in a non-cash intangible asset impairment charge of twelve million one hundred eighty-one thousand dollars.
changes.evidence: As part of our strategic evolution, in October 2025, Ultralife decided to undergo a comprehensive rebranding initiative that consolidates all sub-brands under a singular, unified master brand – Ultralife.
